modeReason: Three stories today (the skin-cancer CNN result, the price collapse, and the grading-despair story) each reach relevance 8 (novelty×magnitude×breadth), clearing the fresh threshold of 8, so the slopper stands on its own without referencing yesterday's slopper.
phrase: Frontier AI models just got up to 80% cheaper. A ten-year-old image classifier still beats them at spotting skin cancer.
phraseAlternatives: AI chatbots got up to 80% cheaper this year. A decade-old specialist model still beats them at reading skin scans for cancer.
The newest AI models now cost far less to run. A ten-year-old tool still outperforms them at one job: spotting skin cancer.
Top AI labs cut their prices by up to 80%. The model that still wins at skin cancer diagnosis is ten years old.
Everyone's AI got cheaper this year. The one that beats it at diagnosing skin cancer has been around for a decade.

brief.concept: Frontier AI chatbots show off steep discount price tags while a small, old-fashioned scanner robot quietly posts a taller bar on a skin-cancer diagnosis chart than any of them.
brief.metaphor: Bigger and cheaper is not the same as better: a decade-old specialist tool still outperforms shiny new general-purpose AI at its own specialty.

cast.who: a row of three large, shiny chatbot robots, each wearing a discount price tag
a small, plain, boxy scanner robot standing apart from the big robots
a simple bar chart labeled ACCURACY, its tallest bar beside the small scanner robot
a human doctor standing between the two groups, looking at the chart with surprise

brief.composition: Left: three large chatbot robots in a row, each with a discount price tag dangling from its chest, looking pleased with themselves. Right: one small, plain, boxy scanner robot stands in front of a bar chart labeled ACCURACY; its bar is the tallest on the chart, taller than any bar near the big robots. A human doctor stands in the middle, looking at the chart with surprise. Only one text label in the whole image: ACCURACY.
brief.alt: Three large shiny chatbot robots wear discount price tags and look pleased with themselves. Beside them, a small plain scanner robot stands in front of a bar chart where its own bar is the tallest, as a human doctor looks on in surprise.
